Ogni finestra lavora su un set di dati:: Each window works on one data set: pick an existing one (not open elsewhere) or create a new one.
Il set è già aperto in un'altra finestra: The set is already open in another window
I dati sono salvati in set indipendenti:: Data is saved in independent sets: closing a window does not delete it. Each window opens one set at a time.
Un unico file zip con tutti i set di dat: A single zip file with all data sets, attachments, window layout and preferences.
Esportati {n} set di dati ({t} task) in: Exported {n} data sets ({t} tasks) to a zip
Backup del {date}: {n} set di dati, {tas: Backup of {date}: {n} data sets, {tasks} tasks, {lists} lists, {groups} groups, {files} attachments.
Crea un set separato per ogni set del ba: Creates a separate set for each set in the backup, leaving existing data untouched. Open them later from Settings → Data.
Elimina tutti i dati attuali e ripristin: Deletes all current data and restores the backup's sets, windows and preferences.
Tutti i set di dati attuali verranno eli: All current data sets will be deleted and replaced by those in the backup; open windows will be closed and recreated as in the backup. This cannot be undone.

Aggiunge ogni set del backup come set se: Adds each backup set as a separate set, leaving existing data untouched. If a name is already in use, (2), (3)… is appended. Open them later from Settings → Data.
Elimina tutti i set attuali e ripristina: Deletes all current sets and restores those in the backup, with windows and preferences.
Questa è l'ultima finestra. Vuoi uscire: This is the last window. Do you want to quit the app or keep it running in the tray? Your data is already saved.
Il file non è uno zip valido: The file is not a valid zip

Alla chiusura dell'ultima finestra toodl: When you close the last window, toodly asks whether to quit or stay in the tray.
Esiste già un gruppo con questo nome: A group with this name already exists
Incolla o scrivi un task per riga (testo: Paste or type one task per line (plain text or Markdown): empty lines are ignored. With Markdown, headings (#, ##, ###…) create groups and subgroups that contain the following lines. Titles longer than {n} characters are shortened and the rest goes into the description.
Elimina definitivamente tutti i set, i t: Permanently deletes all sets, tasks, attachments and preferences.
Sei sicuro di voler cancellare completam: Are you sure you want to completely delete all data? All data sets with their tasks, lists, groups, notes and attachments will be permanently deleted, along with local preferences. This cannot be undone: if you want to keep anything, export a backup from “Data” first.
Completa qualche task per vedere il temp: Complete a few tasks to see the average closing time.

Premi Ctrl+K per cercare nei titoli e ne: Press Ctrl+K to search titles and descriptions, filter by list and priority, and jump straight to the task.
Ctrl+Z annulla le ultime operazioni (anc: Ctrl+Z undoes the latest operations (deletions too), Ctrl+Y redoes them. After a deletion you also get an “Undo” button.
Nel dettaglio di un task scegli un prome: Pick a reminder in a task's details: you'll get a system notification, even with toodly in the tray.

Salva periodicamente un backup completo: Periodically saves a full backup to the chosen folder (while toodly is running) and keeps only the latest ones.
